summary: The header area at the top of whatever content is currently showing in the sidebar.
description: One shared header shown over whichever sidebar panel is open, with the panel title and a close button; the single #sidebar-panel-header instance is declared in browser-box.inc.xhtml, and browser-sidebar.js drives it with setView(). In horizontal-tabs "hide-launcher" mode the title is replaced by the sidebar-panel-switcher dropdown, since there is no launcher to switch panels with.

attributes.name: view
attributes.description: The view id of the panel currently shown; normally set by setView(). Passed to the internal close moz-button and the sidebar-panel-switcher. The close button renders only while view is set.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The panel title text rendered in the header; normally computed by setView() from the panel's revampL10nId (its Fluent label) or label.

attributes.name: panel-has-custom-header
attributes.description: Internal state hook, toggled by setView() from the panel registry's hasCustomHeader; not set by consumers.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: setView(view): sets view, computes heading from the panel registry entry, and toggles panel-has-custom-header; called by browser-sidebar.js when a panel is shown.
